description: This Java class 'MapStack' extends 'MapContext' and implements a specialized stack of Map objects. It allows creation of nested map contexts, sharing of map states, and context-specific retrieval. The class includes methods for creating new stacks, sharing and extending existing stacks, and overriding 'get' and 'put' methods for context-awareness and debugging.

classes.name: MapStack
classes.description: A specialized stack of Map objects supporting shared contexts and cloning features.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new MapStack with an initial context.

methods.name: create (with Map parameter)
methods.description: Creates a new MapStack initialized with a given Map or another MapStack.

methods.name: standAloneStack
methods.description: Returns a new MapStack sharing the same contexts.

methods.name: standAloneChildStack
methods.description: Returns a new MapStack with the same contexts plus a pushed new Map.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value by key, returning self if key is 'context'.

methods.name: get (with Locale)
methods.description: Retrieves a value by name considering locale, or the self if name is 'context'.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Inserts a key-value pair, with warning if key is 'context' and value is not self.
